name: Donchian two-sleeve trend
tagline: A fast 20/10 TQQQ Donchian sleeve plus a slow 100/50 QQQ regime sleeve, sized to an 85% vol target.
summary: The fast sleeve re-enters quickly after shakeouts while the slow QQQ regime keeps the book invested through multi-month trends. It clears development at 49.14% CAGR and 43.95% max DD, but the slow 50-session exit is load-bearing and the frozen 2024-26 holdout earns only 3.19% CAGR, leaving the full window below TQQQ.
caveat: The 2024-26 holdout earns only 3.19% CAGR, so the full-window 35.13% finishes 2.41 pp below TQQQ's 37.54%, and the development pass depends on a load-bearing 50-session slow exit.
